label: B. Evidence-led Showroom
prompt:
Edit and substantially recompose this high-fidelity 1536 × 1024 desktop B2B website homepage while preserving its established warm-white, deep-navy, muted-teal and safety-orange visual system, industrial product-photo realism, thin technical rules and strong condensed display typography.

Replace the current hero composition with a clearly different ‘Evidence-led Showroom’ three-column grid directly below the navigation:
1. A narrow left editorial column with the text-only wordmark ‘XINGXU FAN’, ‘Quanzhou Xingxu Fan & Ventilation Supply’, the headline ‘Nearly 30 Years of Hands-On Fan Supply’, a short paragraph stating only that the company supports distributors, contractors and equipment manufacturers in Malaysia and the Philippines, plus orange ‘Request a Quote’ and text-link ‘Explore Products’.
2. A tall central product showcase panel containing one realistic negative pressure fan on a pale matte industrial surface, annotated only with ‘CONCEPT VISUAL — REPLACE WITH REAL PHOTO’.
3. A wide right evidence board titled ‘REAL BUSINESS EVIDENCE’, arranged as a compact 2 × 2 contact sheet. Its four deliberately greyed visual placeholders must be labelled ‘Storefront’, ‘Warehouse’, ‘Product’, and ‘Nameplate’, each carrying the clear overlay ‘PHOTO PLACEHOLDER’. Add exactly this note: ‘Real business photos and product details will be added before launch.’

Place a thin full-width capability rail below the three-column hero with only these labels: ‘Selection Advice’, ‘Cross-Brand Sourcing’, and ‘Export Packaging & Logistics Coordination’. Start the next section at the lower edge with ‘Industrial Fan Categories’ and category labels ‘Negative Pressure Fans’, ‘Axial Fans’, and ‘Centrifugal Fans’.

Keep navigation links Products, Applications, For Distributors, Resources, About, and the orange Request a Quote button. Remove the decorative fan-shaped logo icon and use a text-only wordmark. Remove all other marketing phrases and unsupported claims, especially ‘Reliable Airflow for Real Projects’, ‘Supporting Partners’, ‘Built for Real-World Applications’, ‘reliable supply partner’, ‘leading brands’, and any claim not explicitly listed here. Do not add a founding year, model numbers, technical specifications, prices, certification badges, client logos, customer statistics, export history, factory or manufacturing claims, flags, maps, or contact handles. Make this composition materially different from the original split hero: the evidence board must be a first-class right column, not a horizontal strip beneath an unchanged hero. Keep all UI text legible and make the page look like a finished premium website screenshot rather than a poster.
